query: '
SELECT
    DATEADD(
        DAY,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1,
        CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE)
    ) AS fecha_completa
FROM sys.all_objects a
CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b
',

query: '
WITH diagnostico_principal AS (
    SELECT
        admission_id,
        icd_code,
        diagnosis_description,
        severity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY admission_id
            ORDER BY diagnosis_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM silver.diagnoses
)
SELECT
    a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    p.paciente_key,
    dep.departamento_key,
    diag.diagnostico_key,
    fi.fecha_key AS fecha_ingreso_key,
    fa.fecha_key AS fecha_alta_key,
    a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,
    CASE
        WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE DATEDIFF(DAY, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date)
    END AS dias_estancia,
    CAST(1 AS INT) AS conteo_admisiones
FROM silver.admissions a
INNER JOIN gold.dim_paciente p
    ON p.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
INNER JOIN gold.dim_departamento dep
    ON dep.nombre_departamento = a.department
INNER JOIN diagnostico_principal dp
    ON dp.admission_id = a.admission_id
    AND dp.rn = 1
INNER JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico diag
    ON diag.codigo_icd = dp.icd_code
    AND ISNULL(diag.descripcion_patologia, '') =
        ISNULL(dp.diagnosis_description, '')
    AND diag.nivel_severidad = dp.severity
INNER JOIN gold.dim_fecha fi
    ON fi.fecha_completa = a.admission_date
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_fecha fa
    ON fa.fecha_completa = a.discharge_date',

query: 'SELECT
    b.billing_id AS billing_id_bk,
    b.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    p.paciente_key,
    dep.departamento_key,
    sc.servicio_cargo_key,
    f.fecha_key AS fecha_pago_key,
    b.amount AS monto_facturado,
    CAST(1 AS INT) AS conteo_transacciones
FROM silver.billing b
INNER JOIN silver.admissions a
    ON a.admission_id = b.admission_id
INNER JOIN gold.dim_paciente p
    ON p.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
INNER JOIN gold.dim_departamento dep
    ON dep.nombre_departamento = a.department
INNER JOIN gold.dim_servicio_cargo sc
    ON sc.tipo_cargo = b.charge_type
    AND sc.estado_pago = b.payment_status
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_fecha f
    ON f.fecha_completa = b.payment_date',

query: 'SELECT a.*
FROM bronze.admissions a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM silver.patients p
    WHERE p.patient_id = a.patient_id
)',

query: 'SELECT d.*
FROM bronze.diagnoses d
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM silver.admissions a
    WHERE a.admission_id = d.admission_id
)',

query: 'SELECT b.*
FROM bronze.billing b
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM silver.admissions a
    WHERE a.admission_id = b.admission_id
)',
